verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM has a first-party docs page titled "MCP Compatibility in AnythingLLM", which points to native MCP support for its agents. But the pack gives only that title, with no detail on how MCP servers are added or how agents call their tools. The probe's "official MCP server" label concerns a different role and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented steps for configuring MCP servers, supported transports (stdio/SSE), evidence that agents can discover and invoke MCP tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
